goal: J3: a material-risk scripted task dispatches a reviewer whose receipt arrives through the MCP tool and is recorded as a verdict (Spec D2, J3) (Initiative e2e-release-gate slice S5; Spec docs/specs/e2e-release-gate.spec.md).

acceptance.assertion: bun run e2e review runs a material-risk scripted task whose reviewer submits its receipt through the MCP review tool and the verdict is recorded on the TaskRecord. Negative case: a reviewer that ends without submitting a receipt yields the named refusal and no verdict. Done looks like: tests/e2e/review.e2e.ts passes with the negative asserted. Prerequisite: the pinned claude binary from tests/e2e/hosts.json is installed on the QA host (maintainer machine provides claude 2.1.330); an absent binary fails the check rather than skipping.
